apiKey.title: SynapCores API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the SynapCores gateway (ak_prod_... or aidb_...), or use the ${SYNAPCORES_API_KEY} environment variable.

useHttps.title: Use HTTPS
useHttps.description: Connect to the SynapCores gateway over TLS.

collection.title: Memory Collection
collection.description: SynapCores collection name used to store memories.

graph.title: Memory Graph
graph.description: SynapCores graph name used for memory relations (SIMILAR_TO edges + recallRelated walks).

autoCapture.title: Auto-Capture (opt-in)
autoCapture.description: Opt-in; default off. When enabled, the plugin automatically stores conversation-derived facts to your SynapCores gateway and turns on pre-compaction memory flushing. Leave off (the default) to keep the plugin passive — memory is written only when you explicitly call memory_store or the `ltm` command.

autoRecall.title: Auto-Recall (opt-in)
autoRecall.description: Opt-in; default off. When enabled, the plugin automatically injects relevant stored memories into the model's context on each turn. Leave off to recall only when you explicitly call memory_recall.

autoLinkSimilar.title: Auto-Link Similar Memories (opt-in)
autoLinkSimilar.description: Opt-in; default off. Only applies when autoCapture is enabled. On capture, draws SIMILAR_TO graph edges to existing memories with cosine similarity > 0.7 so recallRelated returns useful neighborhoods (adds ~30-50ms per capture).

workspace.title: Workspace ID
workspace.description: Optional workspace name suffixed onto the AutoML relevance model so multiple installations sharing one gateway can train independent models.
